external_side_effects.verification: before every direct, serial, batch, or single upload request, authorization context must exactly bind the AllinCMS site, operation, ordered file-list digest, asserted approval actor, approval time, and bounded expiry; the adapter fails closed before browser or CMS access when the binding is absent or mismatched

before every article, taxonomy, or article-image draft mutation request, a structured authorization context must exactly bind the AllinCMS site, operation, target digest, asserted approval actor, approval time, and expiry of no more than 30 minutes; the adapter revalidates immediately before the request and fails closed on absent, boolean, expired, or mismatched authorization

rollback_strategy: stop at the last verified artifact; restore from the writeback record and adapter-specific rollback instructions; never infer rollback success from a toast alone.
writeback_scope: general methods and anonymized failure patterns may return to the public mother library; customer facts and runtime evidence remain in the customer private runtime.
unsupported_claims: official API availability for observed internal endpoints
stable installable Skill before release gate
human identity verification from local approval or authorization records
